newsitem.title: UK: Carling renews 4-year premier league deal.
newsitem.headline: Carling renews 4-year premier league deal.

text.p: Lager giant Carling, a subsidiary of brewer-to-leisure group Bass, said on Tuesday it has renewed a four year deal to sponsor Britain's premier football league worth 36 million stg.
The deal replaces its original 12 million stg, four year contract which expires this summer.
According to newspaper reports Carling fought off competition from British Telecommunications Plc and Ford.

"I think the chairmen of the premier league clubs saw continuity as an advantage, we have a working relationship with them and most importantly we have built up a great deal of trust," said Johnathan Nye, head of sponsorship for Bass. Carling sold 1.1 billion stg worth of lager last year and since sponsorhip of the league began its sales have been rising while overall market sales of lager have fallen, said Nye. The sponsorship money will be shared equally among the 20 league clubs. "We have shown ourselves to be a dynamic, creative and a responsible and credible sponsor," said Nye.

Most of the bigger clubs now make twice as much from outside sources as they do from ticket sales at the gate, Manchester United leads the pack with a turnover of 53.3 million stg in the yera to July 31, 1996.
